ambiguities: Inclusivity at the target rests on the official text alone: none of twenty observed settlements landed on its target.
The interpolation cannot be replayed from the public info and WebSocket API. Node-level data has not been examined.

observation: One instant, the expiry: linear interpolation between the HyperCore mark price updates immediately before and after it. Not a TWAP, not a candle close, not the oracle price.

quotes: the contract settles to YES if and only if `markPrice0 + (settlementTime - t0) / (t1 - t0) * (markPrice1 - markPrice0) ≥ targetPrice`
sources.title: Hyperliquid docs: Contract specifications, Recurring outcomes

quotes: Settlement automatically converts either Yes to `settleFraction` quote tokens and No to `1 - settleFraction` quote tokens.
sources.title: Hyperliquid docs: HIP-4 Outcome markets, Mechanics
